scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @rummikub/server" "npm run dev -w @rummikub/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rummikub/rules && npm run build -w @rummikub/protocol && npm run build -w @rummikub/platform && npm run build -w @rummikub/server && npm run build -w @rummikub/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rummikub/rules && npm run test -w @rummikub/rules && npm run test -w @rummikub/server && npm run test -w @rummikub/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rummikub/rules && npm run typecheck -w @rummikub/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @rummikub/platform && npm run typecheck -w @rummikub/server && npm run typecheck -w @rummikub/client
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build -w @rummikub/client && npx cap sync ios --prefix apps/client && npx cap open ios --prefix apps/client
scripts.cap:android: npm run build -w @rummikub/client && npx cap sync android --prefix apps/client && npx cap open android --prefix apps/client
